newsitem.title: USA: Liposome stake raised by Kenneth Dart.
newsitem.headline: Liposome stake raised by Kenneth Dart.

text.p: A group led by Kenneth Dart, president of Dart Container Corp, said Friday it raised its stake in Liposome Co Inc to 7,514,346 Series A common shares or 20.19 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 1,025,000 shares between April 30 and May 1 at prices ranging from $21.75 to $22 per share.
The group said it holds the stake in the Princeton, N.J., drug company for long-term passive investment.
